spec.title: Alignment A3, second half: every proposal for examples 121-139 checked by the regression proof, and scored
spec.description: jvmcontract align --prove (new, lib/src/alignment/proofs.rs) runs the regression check (equivalence, as a caller) on every complete mapping align proposes for a pair, with the flags it amounts to, collapses proved mappings that give the old version the same observations, and settles the pair: one proved (evidence for its claim key, intent still proposed), several (a question), or none (each tried with its counterexample). examples/tools/alignment.py score --step proofs runs it on each of the 19 regression examples 121-139 for the table's pair, under the example's own scope (--unchanged-unless) and proof options (engine, gaps, unwind, as build.py gives them), and scores the outcome against the example's verdict: a verified example's hand-written mapping should be the one proved; a violation should leave no mapping proved. Any other proved mapping is 'wrong and accepted', the worst outcome (a mapping hiding a regression). It writes the score to examples/tools/alignment/scores/A3-proofs.json and the page.
spec.expected: exits 0; the printed A3-proofs tally: 'proof, verified' 10 found (121, 123, 125, 127, 129, 131, 133, 135, 137, 138; 123's relation proved but still a person's decision), 'proof, violation' 9 found (122, 124, 126, 128, 130, 132, 134, 136, 139: none proved, counterexamples shown), nothing wrong, and wrongAndAccepted empty in scores/A3-proofs.json. Any example listed under wrongAndAccepted is a finding for the alignment stream.
